'''Zin Taal''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]]. By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[First Sun Mobile Regiment]] established a [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] base there. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], intending to capture the base, [[Mission to Zin Taal|dispatched]] a [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|New Republic Special Forces]] strike force that was dropped onto the world. The team's mission on Zin Taal was eventually complicated by an unforeseen circumstance.

==Description==
Zin Taal was a remote terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Journal15" /> located in the [[Zin Taal system/Legends|Zin Taal system]], a part of the [[Carrion sector/Legends|Carrion sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Zintaal was inhabited by a group of [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] inhabitants.<ref name="Journal15" /> By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}} is set after the final [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref> the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit known as the [[First Sun Mobile Regiment]] established a temporary [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] base on Zin Taal. Eventually, the [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|New Republic Special Forces]] assembled a strike force in order to [[Mission to Zin Taal|capture]] the base-camp, which [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] estimated to have been established within the prior three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] and which was prognosticated to remain in place for at least another [[Standard month/Legends|month]] before being relocated.<ref name="Journal15" />

The strike force was provided with [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] images of the First Sun Mobile Regiment's base that depicted patrol patterns and lookout posts. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents were also shown the best lines of approaching the mercenary camp. After an uneventful journey to Zin Taal, the strike force was dropped from a [[Dropship/Legends|shuttle]] in a manner appropriate to the team's specialty. The strike force then made its way to the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment's]] base, although an unforeseen event complicated the mission.<ref name="Journal15" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Special_Military_Unit_Intelligence_Update_SWJ15.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Zin Taal was introduced in the article "Special Military Unit Intelligence Update."]]
Zin Taal was mentioned in "[[Special Military Unit Intelligence Update]]," a [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15]].<ref name="Journal15" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zin Taal [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Zin Taal itself, in grid square J-4.<ref name="TEA" />

In "Special Military Unit Intelligence Update," Zin Taal is presented as a setting for an [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed. The exact nature of the complication the New Republic agents encounter on the world is left up to the gamemaster player, with the suggested options being the detection of the player characters' [[Shuttle/Legends|drop-shuttle]]; the mercenary base being put on high alert in response to an attack by Zin Taal's natives; and the base moving sooner than anticipated. For the last option, the adventure seed also provides several possible reasons: the regiment taking on a new contract; the New Republic mission being leaked; or the mercenary unit's [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maska Zural]] being nervous.<ref name="Journal15" />
